summary: Short dead-end bend of Shirley Street ringed by homes and apartments.
reasons: Dwellings 12-23 m away on all sides
Level, kerb space with parked car

best_section.where: Dead-end bend of Shirley Street, south kerb by the grass strip

drivers.seclusion: Residential house 12 m, others 19-28 m, apartments and a kindergarten close by; tree cover helps.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street, car parked at the kerb, grass verge gives room.
drivers.traffic: Quiet dead-end street, little through traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park here; 2P weekday 9-5, no-stopping at set times on some signs.

sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy from the east and north; open to the west.
